CustomField.description: Implemented as a part of the FY25 Partner Redesign project. Jira ticket SS-7691
CustomField.formula:
IF(Partner_Rebate_Override__c > 0, Partner_Rebate_Override__c, IF(!Partner_Rebate_Eligible__c, 0, IF(AND(Max_Computed_Term__c <= 12, (Partner_Rebate_Eligible_Quote_Lines_Sum__c * VALUE($Label.Partner_Rebate_Percent)/100) < 500000), Partner_Rebate_Eligible_Quote_Lines_Sum__c * VALUE($Label.Partner_Rebate_Percent)/100 , IF((12 * (Partner_Rebate_Eligible_Quote_Lines_Sum__c / Max_Computed_Term__c) * VALUE($Label.Partner_Rebate_Percent)/100) < 500000, 12 * (Partner_Rebate_Eligible_Quote_Lines_Sum__c / Max_Computed_Term__c) * VALUE($Label.Partner_Rebate_Percent)/100, 500000))))
/* IF(Partner_Rebate_Override__c > 0, Partner_Rebate_Override__c, IF(!Partner_Rebate_Eligible__c, 0, IF(Max_Computed_Term__c <= 12, Partner_Rebate_Eligible_Quote_Lines_Sum__c * VALUE($Label.Partner_Rebate_Percent)/100, (12 * (Partner_Rebate_Eligible_Quote_Lines_Sum__c / Max_Computed_Term__c) * VALUE($Label.Partner_Rebate_Percent)/100)))) */
CustomField.inlineHelpText: This is the Rebate amount that will be paid to the partner
CustomField.label: DEPRECATED - Partner Rebate ($)
